description: More proof of income, more deposit, a guarantor, a co-signer - each defensible individually and collectively a surcharge.
energy_note: Always one more document than the man in front.

aspect: Cash is suspicious and he is paid in cash
description: Informal and day-labour work pays cash (ECO-001, WRK-002), and cash deposits trigger scrutiny - so the employment condition produces the financial suspicion.
energy_note: Paid in the way that makes banks distrust him.

aspect: He pre-empts it, at his own cost
description: Carrying paperwork nobody asks of others, arriving early, dressing up for a routine appointment - unpaid, invisible, continuous.
energy_note: Dressed for court, to open a bank account.

description: The apartment asks first month, last month and a deposit - and then, for him, a co-signer with US credit history. He has been at the same job for six years and has the cash in an envelope. The cash is part of the problem.
energy_note: Having the money in cash counts against him.
